tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Checks one email address without sending anything: format, typo in big providers ("gmail.com.br" → "gmail.com", "hotmial.com"), disposable inbox, shared mailbox (contato@, sales@) and whether the domain receives email (MX). Verdict valid, risky or invalid, with did_you_mean. The mailbox itself is ne

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Batch of verify_email: the same checks for up to 100 addresses at once, one verdict each (valid, risky, invalid) plus the totals. Run it before a send and drop invalid and disposable addresses. Each address counts in the daily limit. Free, read only. / Confere até 100 endereços de uma vez antes de u

tools.name: check_domain_dns
tools.description: Checks the email setup of any domain: SPF (one record, ending, the 10 DNS lookup limit), DKIM on the common selectors (or dkim_selector), DMARC policy and reports, MX and mailbox provider, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. Answers a 0 to 100 score, a grade, the fix for each problem in plain words and recor

tools.name: explain_smtp_error
tools.description: Explains a bounce or SMTP error text ("550 5.7.515 Access denied", "452 4.2.2 mailbox full") in plain words: hard (the address does not work), soft (temporary) or policy (a provider rule, not the address), the provider and the next step. Free, read only. / Explica uma devolução ou erro SMTP em lingu

tools.name: generate_spf
tools.description: Builds one SPF record (TXT at the domain) from the services that send for it: includes, IPv4 and IPv6, mx and a. Starts with ~all (softfail), the safe choice; use policy fail (-all) once every sender is listed. Remember the limit of 10 DNS lookups (each include costs at least one). Free, no network.

tools.name: generate_dmarc
tools.description: Builds one DMARC record (TXT at _dmarc.<domain>). Start with policy none and a report address (rua), read the reports, then move to quarantine and reject once every legitimate sender passes SPF or DKIM aligned. Free, no network. / Monta o registro DMARC; comece com p=none e suba para quarantine e re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "tools" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_emails, check_domain_dns, explain_smtp_error · Private data: check_domain_dns, generate_spf, generate_dmarc · Public sink: verify_email, verify_emails, check_domain_dns, generate_spf · Destructive: verify_email, verify_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_emails, check_domain_dns, explain_smtp_error · Private data: check_domain_dns, generate_spf, generate_dmarc · Public sink: verify_email, verify_emails, check_domain_dns, generate_spf · Destructive: verify_email, verify_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
